- Sub-acute grief can last from a few months to a year. During this period, you may experience a decrease in the intensity of your emotional pain, but you may still experience some physical and emotional symptoms.
- Prolonged grief can last from a year or more. This type of grief is often seen in people who have experienced traumatic losses, such as the loss of a child or a loved one in a tragic accident.
